name: Summer Fenn
activities: Red Cross Lifeguard and WSI certification
description_short: Summer Fenn is a day camp in Concord, MA. Its Base Camp is a general day camp for children entering grades K-10, and SF Junior is a full-day program for 4- and 5-year-olds. It also runs specialty, outdoor expedition and off-site day-trip camps. Camp runs 9:00am-3:45pm, mostly in two-week sessions.
refund_policy_summary: 2026 policy: tuition is fully refundable until March 31, less a $100 per week, per child deposit; after March 31 a 25% refund until 2 weeks before the program starts; no refunds within 2 weeks of the start. Cancellations must be emailed in writing.
swim_waterfront_notes: The Fenn School campus has a 30' x 75' heated swimming pool. Swim lessons are offered after camp at an extra charge, and Red Cross Lifeguard and Water Safety Instructor (WSI) certification courses are also offered.
